why: I checked the verifier brief's Check 4, which covers expect line 4. It runs `curl -sS -L https://o.github.io/greet-cli/ | grep -n -- '--shout'` and grades on the result. It PASSes if "the published page fetched by curl contains `--shout`" and FAILs if "the page does not contain `--shout`, or it cannot be fetched". So it fetches the live page and gives PASS or FAIL based on what the page shows today. That is must_not item 1. Telling the verifier to "Report FAIL and say the cause is that the PR is not yet merged" doesn't fix this: the verdict still comes from the live fetch, and it fails a post-merge condition that can't be checked at the PR head. The brief does avoid item 2, since nothing passes silently without evidence. The builder brief breaks neither item. Because item 1 is violated, the criterion is not met.
